The Topology Boundary Auditor confirmed the sunglasses themselves have high mask confidence (0.99), indicating the primary subject is structurally sound, which isolates the artifacts to the background/secondary elements. The severity ratings are appropriate; the structural collapse is noticeable but does not destroy the entire image composition.
